caption: This is a grayscale drawing that depicts a teapot or kettle with an ornate design, resting on a decorative stand. The teapot has a rounded body with a short, wide spout on the left and an elaborate, curved handle at the top, both embellished with intricate floral and scrollwork patterns. The lid of the teapot is domed, features a detailed border with leaf and vine motifs, and is topped with a small, round knob. The teapot sits on a stand that has three detailed supports, each decorated with vine and floral patterns and ending in small scrolls at the base. Below the teapot, centrally placed between the supports, appears to be a burner or heating element, also detailed with small ornate patterns and placed on a round tray-like base. The drawing is rendered in fine lines and shading on an off-white or light beige background, giving a clear representation of the metallic and ornamental features of the objects. There is a small scale marked “3 inches” in the lower left corner and a signature in the bottom right corner.
title: Silver Kettle with Lamp & Stand
